_doc: Point-in-time retrospective. Every input was public on as_of; see sources. Hindsight lives only in outcome.json.
methodology: house v2 (EPP-distance adjustment), 6-section format; retro method r2: scenario inputs derived from dated facts by frozen rules (retro/README.md); personal-computer and consumer-electronics signals

pit_profile.why: Apple: it 'designs and develops nearly the entire solution for its products, including the hardware, operating system, numerous software applications, and related services', and is the 'only authorized maker of hardware using the Mac OS', which 'has a minority market share in the personal computer market' (its own FY2010 10-K); 317 retail stores; it 'competes in highly competitive global markets characterized by aggressive price cutting, with resulting downward pressure on gross margins': a margin risk, not an obsolescence one

classification.quality_note: Apple: it 'designs and develops nearly the entire solution for its products, including the hardware, operating system, numerous software applications, and related services', and is the 'only authorized maker of hardware using the Mac OS', which 'has a minority market share in the personal computer market' (its own FY2010 10-K); 317 retail stores; it 'competes in highly competitive global markets characterized by aggressive price cutting, with resulting downward pressure on gross margins': a margin risk, not an obsolescence one. durable franchise (obsolescence risk 2/5); price cheap; Ratio B 0.06x; +18% to EPP floor; model-vs-market gap +1.37; conservative 2yr +136%.

BEAR.desc: Flat EPS (worst year FY03-FY10, capped at 0%); P/E to its 10th pct

BASE.desc: EPS +43.3%/yr (Q1 guide + margin + buyback); P/E at its 8.2-yr median

BULL.desc: EPS +111.5%/yr (FY03-FY10 CAGR); P/E holds its 75th pct

XBULL.desc: EPS +340.2%/yr (best 2-yr run FY03-FY10); P/E at its 90th pct

summary: AAPL (retrospective, 2010-12-17) ◉ BUY — Ratio B 0.06x (37.6% downside to Bear $200 / +601.8% upside to Bull $2250) | Adj composite 2.59 vs market 1.22: gap +1.37 [UNDERVALUED] | +18% above the EPP floor $273 (18x FY11E $15.15) | Conservative 2-yr case: +135.7% total (+67.9%/yr) | At 21.2x FY11E the 15% hurdle price $424 sits at or below the BASE case; Mac units +27.3% in Q4 FY10, forward net sales +46.7% (Q1 FY11 revenue guide); no disruption theme has dated evidence.

sources.title: Apple Inc. FY2010 10-K
sources.supports: selected financial data FY2006-FY2010 (net sales, diluted EPS, diluted shares 924,712K in FY10 and 877,526K in FY06); income statement FY2008-FY2010; net sales and unit sales by product FY2008-FY2010; cash flow; no dividends in 2010 or 2009; no debt outstanding; 317 retail stores; competition and Mac OS wording; gross margin expectation 'about 36% in the first quarter of 2011'

sources.title: Apple Inc. FY2009 10-K/A (retrospective adoption of the new accounting principles)

sources.title: Apple Inc. FY2008 10-K

sources.title: Apple Inc. FY2007 10-K
